units.source_text: 他握住了六条妃子的手，依依不舍，那样子真是多情！

en.t: He held Lady Rokujo's hand, reluctant to part from her; he looked truly full of tender feeling.

units.source_text: 其时凉风忽起，秋虫乱鸣，其声哀怨，似乎代人惜别。

en.t: Just then a cool wind suddenly rose, and autumn insects began crying all around; their mournful voices seemed to grieve over the parting in people's stead.

units.source_text: 即使是无忧无虑之人，听到这声音也难于忍受。

en.t: Even someone free from care or sorrow would have found those sounds hard to bear.

units.source_text: 何况这两个魂销肠断的恋侣，哪有心情从容赋诗呢？

en.t: How much less could these two heartbroken lovers have the composure to exchange poems at leisure?
